services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Secure your spot on a private tour of the Society’s newest exhibition, The American Wedding: A Revolution in Style and Tradition! This guided experience, led by Marie Schlag, Textile Conservator and Exhibition Curator, offers an in-depth look at the stories behind the gowns, bringing to life the women who wore them
